personal.name: Priyank Agrawal
personal.title: PhD Candidate
personal.tagline: RL for LLMs · Post-training · Agentic AI

paragraphs: I'm a final-year PhD candidate at Columbia University, advised by Shipra Agrawal. I work on reinforcement learning for LLMs, from principled algorithm design to multi-GPU training runs.

As a student researcher at Meta (Nov 2025 – Apr 2026), I built Off-Context GRPO, an RLVR method for problems a model can't yet solve. It samples rollouts with hints and applies a per-token importance-sampling correction, so training still optimizes for the problem without hints. I implemented it on a patched veRL / vLLM / Ray stack and ran experiments on models up to 14B parameters. The code and project page are public.

I've also designed principled RL algorithms — Q-learning with optimism and with posterior sampling, and single-timescale actor-critic — published at COLT 2025, ICLR 2026, and NeurIPS 2025. I'm now working on credit assignment for long-horizon agentic tasks with sparse rewards and expensive environment access.
Before Columbia, I did an MS in Computer Science at UIUC with Nan Jiang and built high-throughput, low-latency risk systems at Goldman Sachs. Reach out if you'd like to chat!
